versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-pai-node-management v0.0.1

- Overhauled skill initialization: now requires generating a unique session ID and passing a strict `--user-agent` flag for every cloud API CLI call.
- Refined out-of-scope/forbidden operation wording: all node power/reboot/migration escalation language is now strictly in English and must reference the platform Ops team/Lingjun ops ticket/account manager, with prescribed forbidden strings.
- Updated core workflow and refusal handling per stricter compliance guidelines in internal references.
- Major documentation rewrite: clarified boundaries, lifecycle requirements, and filtered out previously mixed language/wording rules.
- Removed legacy `skill-card.md` and reorganized references for parameter handling and confirmation/rejection protocols.
- No functional API changes; primary impact is on compliance, user interaction, and agent execution hygiene.

alibabacloud-pai-node-management 0.0.1-beta.1

- Initial beta release enabling inventory, inspection, and basic operations (cordon/uncordon/drain) of Alibaba Cloud PAI Nodes via the `aliyun paistudio` CLI plugin.
- Supports listing nodes within a ResourceGroup or Quota, retrieving node details including resource allocation, and node operation workflows.
- Scope is strictly enforced: direct node access (e.g. SSH, kubectl) and power/reboot actions are explicitly out of scope and must be refused with appropriate language.
- Requires strict initialization and cleanup of the CLI AI mode at the beginning and end of every operation.
- Provides clear permission requirements, parameter handling, and strong constraints on list/inspection commands per public CLI capabilities.
